items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps young skin comfortable and clean without stripping it.
A mineral SPF 50 fluid is the one product that suits daily wear on young skin.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports skin comfort and suits the moderate moisture score.

response.routine_note: Retinol, vitamin C and the 30 percent peel are not suitable for children under 13, so we have left them out; a simple wash, moisturizer and morning sunscreen is all this shopper needs. If a parent or guardian has skin concerns, a dermatologist is the right person to ask rather than a shop.
